hotel_1star_proxy.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Copenhagen? Hotel Prices for Copenhagen, Denmark | Budget Your Trip
hotel_1star_proxy.evidenceText: The exact-city search result reports $131 as the average price of 9 1-star hotels in Copenhagen and a $123 median; it describes a one-night stay. The same result states that hotel prices are in US Dollars before taxes, and the star table is before taxes and fees.
hotel_1star_proxy.referencePeriod: Search result crawled last week; snippet retrieved 2026-08-01.
hotel_1star_proxy.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com/hotels Copenhagen Denmark 1-star hotel average price one night before taxes
hotel_1star_proxy.reason: Source-defined snippet proxy candidate only: exact city/class, numeric one-night USD average, and explicit pre-tax basis are present; not an observed two-adult product value.

double_occupancy_semantics.sourceTitle: Copenhagen Travel Cost - Average Price of a Vacation to Copenhagen: Food & Meal Budget, Daily & Weekly Expenses | BudgetYourTrip.com
double_occupancy_semantics.evidenceText: The exact-city same-source search result states: the average price paid in Copenhagen for two people for a typical double-occupancy hotel room is $193 (kr1,255). It also states that one person sharing averages $96 (kr627) per night and that costs are from reported traveler spending.
double_occupancy_semantics.occupancyEvidence: The average price paid in Copenhagen for two people for a typical double-occupancy hotel room is $193 (kr1,255).
double_occupancy_semantics.referencePeriod: Search result published 2 months ago and crawled 3 weeks ago; snippet retrieved 2026-08-01.

double_occupancy_semantics.reason: Same-source exact-city snippet supplies explicit two-person/double-occupancy wording; this supports only the labelled one-star proxy candidate.
